info.description:
# CERTInext API v2 - REST APIs RESTful API for CERTInext certificate lifecycle management - issue, track, validate, renew, and revoke certificates programmatically. This collection is curated for **enterprise integrations**: BR-compliant SSL/TLS issuance, AATL-trusted Document Signer, and customer-owned Private PKI. --- ## Three-step setup 1. **Pick your environment** (top-right env dropdown): Production, Sandbox, Demo, QA, or Localhost. 2. **Set credentials** in the environment: `accountNumber` (your account number) and `clientSecret` (the OAuth client secret - generate under **Integrations -> APIs** in the portal, **OAuth mode**). 3. **Get a Bearer token**: open **Authentication -> Get Bearer Token** and hit **Send**. The test script captures `access_token` into `{{accessToken}}` - every other request reuses it automatically. After that, run any folder top-to-bottom. Test scripts auto-capture `orderId`, `requestId`, `domainId` between calls so the next request works without editing. --- ## What's covered | Folder | Endpoints | What you do here | | --- | --- | --- | | **Authentication** | 2 | Mint + refresh OAuth2 Bearer tokens | | **SSL/TLS Certificates** | 22 | Public-trust SSL - 10 product variants (DV and OV in single / Wildcard / UCC / Wildcard UCC, plus EV and EV UCC) and full lifecycle | | **Document Signer Certificates** | 9 | AATL-trusted PDF signing - 3 subject types (Natural / Legal Person / Legal Entity) and lifecycle | | **Private PKI Certificates** | 7 | Customer-CA issuance - 2 variants (Intranet SSL / IGTF Host) and lifecycle | | **Domains** | 10 | Pre-register and validate domains: add, list, view, get DCV, change method, verify, deactivate, last attempt, attempt history, attempt details | | **Accounts** | 4 | Identity, billing groups, organizations | | **Catalog** | 2 | Product entitlements + per-product custom fields | | **Reports** | 2 | Orders report, ledger statement | | **Reference** | 3 | Error codes, product codes, country codes | --- ## SSL/TLS workflow ``` 1. Get Bearer Token 2. Pick the right Create - Variant (DV / DV Wildcard / DV UCC / OV / OV Wildcard / ...) 3. Get DCV Challenges <- optional: defaults to order's primary domain + dns-txt 4. Publish the TXT record / HTTP file / reply to email 5. Verify DCV 6. Submit CSR 7. Accept Agreement 8. Track Order until status = issued 9. Download Certificate <- Accept: application/json | application/x-pem-file | application/pkix-cert ``` Optional: **Cancel** before issuance, **Revoke** after, **Reissue** to rekey or add SANs. ## Document Signer workflow ``` 1. Get Bearer Token 2. Create - Natural Person (or Legal Person, Legal Entity) 3. Upload Documents (multipart) 4. Submit CSR 5. Accept Agreement 6. Track until status = issued 7. Download Certificate ``` ## Private PKI workflow ``` 1. Get Bearer Token 2. Create - Intranet SSL (or IGTF Host) 3. Submit CSR 4. Track until status = issued 5. Download Certificate ``` _No DCV, no Subscriber Agreement, no documents - your CA, your rules._ ## Domains workflow (pre-register) ``` 1. Add Domain <- persists row; method-id resolved against your account 2. Get DCV <- the TXT/HTTP challenge token is generated on first read 3. Publish, then Verify DCV 4. Domain becomes reusable in any later SSL order under the same account ``` Use **Change DCV Method** to switch between DNS-TXT and HTTP-File (dns-txt / http-url). --- ## Conventions | Aspect | Standard | | --- | --- | | Auth header | `Authorization: Bearer` on every protected call | | Token endpoint | `POST /oauth/token` - `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (RFC 6749 section 3.2) | | Timestamps | ISO-8601 with timezone - `2026-05-08T13:00:00Z` (UTC; `06:00 PT` / `09:00 ET`) | | Phones | E.164 - e.g. `+14155551234` | | Countries | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 - `US` for United States | | Currencies | ISO 4217 - `USD`, `CAD`, `MXN` | | State codes | Two-letter state codes - `NY`, `CA`, `TX`, `WA`, `MA` | | Errors | RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` | | IDs | Opaque strings - never parse, never guess | | Pagination | Two styles - see per-endpoint docs:
\- **Domains, DCV attempts** -> `?offset=0&limit=50`
\- **Reports (orders + ledger)** -> `?page=1&size=50` (1-based; `size` clamped to 1-100) | | `X-Product-Code` | Required header on every order create | --- ## Environment variables (collection-managed) | Variable | Filled by | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `accountNumber` | You | Account number from CERTInext portal | | `clientSecret` | You | OAuth client secret (long-lived secret) | | `accessToken` | Get Bearer Token script | Bearer JWT - auto on every call | | `refreshToken` | Get Bearer Token script | Future token refresh | | `orderId` | Create Order scripts | Threaded into lifecycle calls | | `requestId` | Create Order scripts | Draft / reissue requests | | `domainId` | Add Domain script | Threaded into domain lifecycle | | `organizationNumber` | You | Pre-vetted org number for OV orders | | `groupNumber` | You (optional) | Cost-centre allocation | | `productCodeSslDv / DvWildcard / ...` | Pre-filled per env | `X-Product-Code` for SSL variants | | `productCodeDocSignerNp1Y / Lp1Y / Le1Y` | Pre-filled per env | `X-Product-Code` for Document Signer | | `productCodePkiIntranet / Igtf` | Pre-filled per env | `X-Product-Code` for Private PKI | | `caProfileId / masterProductId` | You (optional) | Private PKI override - only set when you need to force a specific CA template / subscription slot. Otherwise the server derives both from `X-Product-Code`. |

request.description:
### What it does
Exchanges your `accountNumber` + `clientSecret` for a short-lived Bearer JWT (RFC 6749 section 3.2 - `client_credentials` grant).

### Request shape
`Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `grant_type` | `client_credentials` |
| `client_id` | `{{accountNumber}}` |
| `client_secret` | `{{clientSecret}}` |

*Alternative: HTTP Basic.* Send `Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)` and omit the body fields. RFC 6749 section 2.3.1 prefers Basic; both are accepted.

### Response (200)
```json
{
 "access_token": "<43-char JWT>",
 "token_type": "Bearer",
 "expires_in": 3600,
 "refresh_token": "<opaque-uuid>"
}
```
`access_token` is captured into `{{accessToken}}` and `refresh_token` into `{{refreshToken}}` - downstream requests use them automatically.

### Common errors
| HTTP | `error` | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | `grant_type` missing or unsupported value | Use `client_credentials` or `refresh_token` |
| 401 | `invalid_client` | Wrong `client_id` / `client_secret`, or key revoked | Regenerate the key in the portal |
| 403 | `unauthorized_client` | Access key not generated in **OAuth mode** | Recreate the key with the OAuth radio selected |

request.description:
### What it does
Rotates the previous refresh token into a new Bearer + new refresh token. Refresh tokens are **single-use** - one call invalidates the prior one.

### When to call
When `{{accessToken}}` is close to expiry and `{{refreshToken}}` is still valid. Saves you from re-hashing credentials.

### Common errors
- `400 invalid_grant` - refresh token expired, already used, or revoked. Call **Get Bearer Token** to re-authenticate from `clientSecret`.

## Response

Same shape as **Get Bearer Token** - the server returns a new pair and revokes the previous access token.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `access_token` | string | Opaque bearer; place in `Authorization: Bearer <value>` for subsequent calls. |
| `token_type` | string | Always `Bearer`. |
| `expires_in` | integer | Seconds until the new access token expires. |
| `refresh_token` | string | New refresh token. The previous one is revoked - use this from now on. |

**Important**: the previous `access_token` is invalidated server-side as soon as this call succeeds. Don't fire `Refresh Token` proactively if you still have time on the current token; the collection's pre-request handles this automatically.

request.description:
### When to use
Single hostname, no organization vetting required. Fastest path to issuance for an app or static site.

### Header
- `X-Product-Code: 842` - DV SSL.

### Body - key fields
| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| `productVariant` | `"dv"` |
| `requestor.phone` | E.164, e.g. `+14155551234` |
| `certificate.domain` | Primary FQDN (no wildcard) |
| `certificate.autoSecureWww` | `true` to auto-add `www.<domain>` |
| `subscription.validityYears` | `1` (3-year SSL retired by BR; multi-year subs renew yearly) |
| `agreement.accepted` | Must be `true` |

## Response (`201 Created`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | Opaque V2 order ID. Use it on every follow-up call (`/dcv`, `/csr`, `/agreement`, track, cancel, revoke, reissue). |
| `requestId` | string | Internal request reference (useful for support tickets). |
| `status` | enum | Initial lifecycle state, typically `pending-dcv`. See status reference below. |
| `productVariant` | enum | Echo of the create-request variant: `dv` / `dv-wildcard` / `dv-ucc` / `dv-wildcard-ucc` / `ov` / `ov-wildcard` / `ov-ucc` / `ov-wildcard-ucc` / `ev` / `ev-ucc`. |
| `domain` | string | Primary (CN) domain on the certificate. |
| `additionalDomains` | string[] | SAN list. Omitted when empty. |
| `createdAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | UTC. |
| `resolvedProductCode` | string | The catalog product code the wrapper picked for this order (e.g. `842` for DV). Useful for billing reconciliation. |

### Status values
Status values are stable lowercase-hyphen strings: `pending-dcv`, `pending-organization-verification`, `pending-csr`, `pending-documents`, `pending-agreement`, `pending-approval`, `issued`, `revoked`, `cancelled`, `rejected`, `expired`, `unknown`.

### Next steps

After Create, capture `orderId` and call **Get DCV Challenges** to fetch the TXT/HTTP token to publish. Follow with **Verify DCV** -> **Submit CSR** -> **Accept Agreement** to reach `issued`.

request.description:
### What it does
Returns the current state of the SSL order - `status`, `domain`, `requestId`, and lifecycle timestamps.

### Status sequence
`pending-dcv` -> `pending-csr` -> `pending-agreement` -> `pending-approval` -> `issued` (or `cancelled` / `revoked` / `expired`)

Poll between lifecycle steps. Returns **404** if the order doesn't exist under your account.

## Response

Same shape as **Create**, plus the lifecycle and supporting blocks filled in as the order progresses.

### Header fields

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | Always. |
| `requestId` | string | Always. |
| `status` | enum | Typed lifecycle state. Walks `pending-dcv` -> `pending-csr` -> `pending-agreement` -> `pending-approval` -> `issued` (or `cancelled` / `revoked` / `expired`). |
| `orderState` | string | Human-readable order status from the legacy pipeline, e.g. `Order Accepted`, `Approved by System`. Complement to the typed `status`. |
| `certificateState` | string | Human-readable certificate / request status, e.g. `Pending for Approver`, `Certificate Generated`. |
| `productVariant` | enum | Echo of the create-request variant. |
| `domain` | string | Primary (CN) domain. |
| `additionalDomains` | string[] | SAN list. Omitted when empty. |
| `interimDvIssued` | boolean | OV/EV only: `true` once the DV interim cert has been issued while OV/EV vetting is still in progress. |
| `createdAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the order was placed. |
| `issuedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the certificate was issued; omitted before issuance. |
| `expiresAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Certificate `notAfter`. Populated once issued; remains populated after revocation / expiry. |

### `requestor`

The person who placed the order; useful for support tickets and audit. PII fields are decrypted from storage.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Full name. |
| `email` | string | Decrypted from storage. |
| `phone` | string | E.164 normalised (`+<isd><number>`). |
| `designation` | string | Job title / role. |

### `csrSubmitted`

Boolean. `true` once the integrator has POSTed a CSR via **Submit CSR**. The order can't progress to issuance until this flips.

### `subscription`

Billing entitlement window. Distinct from the certificate's own `notBefore` / `notAfter`: a single subscription
can host successive certificates (e.g. a re-issued cert during the subscription period).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `validityYears` | integer | Subscription length in years (typically `1`/`2`/`3`). |
| `endDate` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the subscription entitlement expires. |
| `status` | string | `active`, `expired`, or `cancelled`. Omitted when the underlying status is unknown or not yet classified. |

### `subscriberAgreement`

Whether the requestor has accepted the Subscriber Agreement. Returned for product families that require an SA.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `signed` | boolean | `true` once accepted. |
| `signerName` | string | Acceptor's name; omitted until signed. |
| `signedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Acceptance timestamp; omitted until signed. |
| `signedPlace` | string | Acceptor's location; omitted until signed. |

### `revocation` (populated only when `status = revoked`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | Human-readable revocation engine status (e.g. `Revoked`). |
| `reason` | enum | RFC 5280 reason name: `key-compromise`, `affiliation-changed`, `superseded`, `cessation-of-operation`, `certificate-hold`, `privilege-withdrawn`, `unspecified`, etc. |
| `processedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Effective revocation time (CA-recorded). |

### `verifications`

Per-verification-type state. Sub-blocks appear only when the product requires that verification type
For Private PKI this object is typically omitted entirely.

#### `verifications.domain` (SSL/TLS)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | Overall DCV state across all domains on the order: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `domains[]` | array | One entry per domain on the order (primary + SANs). |
|   `.domain` | string | FQDN being validated. |
|   `.domainStatus` | enum | `ACTIVE` / `INACTIVE` / `EXPIRED`. |
|   `.dcvMethod` | enum | `dns-txt` / `http-url`. |
|   `.dcvStatus` | enum | DCV state for this domain: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
|   `.verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When this domain was last successfully validated. |
|   `.caaStatus` | enum | CAA pre-check: `PASSED` / `FAILED` / `SKIPPED`. |

For per-attempt MPIC diagnostics (consensus, DNSSEC, per-perspective resolver results), call the dedicated
**Domains -> Last DCV Attempt** / **DCV Attempt History** endpoints.

#### `verifications.organization` (OV / EV)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `organizationName` | string | Display name as recorded on the order. |
| `consentStatus` | `"0"` \| `"1"` \| `"2"` | Email-consent state when the OV flow requires consent from the organization's primary representative. Omitted when not applicable. |
| `consentSentTo` | string | Email address consent was sent to (when `consentStatus` is present). |

For the full organization record (address, representatives, pre-vetted domains) call
**Accounts -> Get Organization**.

#### `verifications.email` (S/MIME)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `email` | string | Email address being validated (decrypted from storage). |
| `verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the email control challenge was last redeemed. |

#### `verifications.individual` (personal certificates)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `subjectName` | string | Full name as captured at identity check. |
| `verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When identity was last successfully verified. |

Poll Track Order every 30 - 60 seconds while the order is in a `pending-*` state. Stop polling once `status`
reaches a terminal state (`issued`, `cancelled`, `revoked`, `rejected`, `expired`).

request.description:
### What it does
Attaches a PEM-encoded CSR to the order.

### Generating the CSR
```bash
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes \
 -keyout server.key -out server.csr \
 -subj "/CN=www.example.com/O=Acme Corp/L=New York/ST=NY/C=US"
```
For wildcard / UCC: include only the primary domain in `CN`. SANs are taken from the order, not the CSR.

### Body
- `csr` - full PEM with `-----BEGIN/END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----` markers. Newlines must be escaped (`\n`) in JSON.
- `attested` - `true` only when the key was generated by an attested HSM. Defaults to `false`.

### Response
- **204** - CSR accepted.
- **422 EMS-921** - malformed CSR (re-generate from scratch, don't reuse).
- **422 EMS-922** - CSR subject CN doesn't match order's primary domain.

request.description:
### What it does
Reissues an **already-issued** SSL/TLS cert without creating a new order. The `orderId` stays the same; the cert behind it changes.

### Modes
- **`rekey`** - supply a new CSR; existing cert replaced. Use after key rotation, HSM migration, or algorithm/key-size upgrades.
- **`update-sans`** - keep the existing key, add SAN domains via `additionalDomains[]`.

Optionally revoke the previous certificate as part of the same operation by setting `revokePrevious: true` and `revokeReason`.

### Body - rekey example
```json
{
 "mode": "rekey",
 "reason": "Rotating private key after staff offboarding.",
 "csr": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----...",
 "revokePrevious": true,
 "revokeReason": "superseded"
}
```

### Body - update-sans example
```json
{
 "mode": "update-sans",
 "reason": "Adding new sub-domains for the Q3 launch.",
 "additionalDomains": ["api.example.com", "app.example.com"]
}
```

### Response (201)
`Location` header points at the original order; `requestId` points at the new reissue request.

### Common errors (422)
- `EMS-940` malformed CSR
- `EMS-941` reason missing
- `EMS-1063` SAN limit exceeded (per the product's reissue SAN cap)
- Order not in a reissue-able state (cancelled / revoked)

item.description:
Public-trust SSL/TLS issuance - fully **CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements** compliant. Ten product variants, full lifecycle (DCV -> CSR -> Agreement -> Issuance -> Reissue/Revoke).

**Variant guide for enterprises:**
- **DV** - quick, single hostname (e.g. `app.example.com`). Best for static sites, internal tools.
- **DV Wildcard** - single cert protecting `*.example.com` (any sub of one apex). Saves cost; doesn't cover the apex unless added as SAN.
- **DV UCC** - multi-SAN, multiple distinct domains. Up to 250 SANs typical. Used for SaaS multi-tenant deployments.
- **DV Wildcard UCC** - wildcard primary + extra SANs (`*.example.com` + `example.com` + `*.example.net`). Common for multi-brand portfolios.
- **OV** / **OV Wildcard** / **OV UCC** / **OV Wildcard UCC** - same shapes as DV but include vetted organization details in the cert subject. Required for FINRA/HIPAA/PCI footprints, healthcare portals, and customer-trust pages.
- **EV** / **EV UCC** - Extended Validation; strictest organization vetting, single hostname or multi-SAN. For high-assurance brand and customer-trust pages.

Pick **one** create variant, run it, then proceed through DCV -> CSR -> Agreement -> Download.

---

### Field requirements (in body order)

| Field | Mandatory / Optional |
|---|---|
| `productVariant` | **Mandatory** |
| `emailNotifications` | Optional (default `all`) |
| `saveAsDraft` | Optional (default `false`) |
| `requestId` | Conditional - only when promoting a `saveAsDraft` draft |
| `groupNumber` | Optional |
| `requestor` | **Mandatory** |
| `requestor.name` | **Mandatory** |
| `requestor.email` | **Mandatory** |
| `requestor.phone` | Optional |
| `requestor.designation` | Optional |
| `delegation` | Optional |
| `delegation.name` | Optional |
| `delegation.email` | Optional |
| `organization` | Conditional - **Mandatory for OV / EV** |
| `organization.organizationNumber` | Conditional - required if `organization` sent |
| `organization.preVetted` | Optional |
| `organization.preVettingToken` | Optional |
| `certificate` | **Mandatory** |
| `certificate.domain` | **Mandatory** |
| `certificate.additionalDomains` | Conditional - **Mandatory for UCC**, omit otherwise |
| `certificate.autoSecureWww` | Optional (default `true`) |
| `subscription` | Optional |
| `subscription.validityYears` | Optional (default `1`) |
| `subscription.autoRenew` | Optional (default `true` / ON) |
| `subscription.renewBeforeDays` | Optional (default `30`) |
| `agreement` | Optional - required before issuance |
| `agreement.signerName` | Conditional - required if `agreement` sent |
| `agreement.signerPlace` | Conditional - required if `agreement` sent |
| `agreement.accepted` | Conditional - must be `true` if `agreement` sent |
| `csr` | Optional - required before issuance |
| `technicalPointOfContact` | Optional |
| `technicalPointOfContact.name` | Optional |
| `technicalPointOfContact.email` | Optional |
| `technicalPointOfContact.phone` | Optional |
| `technicalPointOfContact.designation` | Optional |
| `recipientEmails` | Optional |
| `tags` | Optional |
| `customFields` | Conditional - only if product mandates |
| `customFields[].fieldId` | Conditional - required if `customFields` sent |
| `customFields[].value` | Conditional - required if `customFields` sent |
| `remarks` | Optional |

**Strictly mandatory** (400 if missing): `productVariant`, `requestor.name`, `requestor.email`, `certificate.domain`.

> **Watch out:** omitting `subscription` does **not** disable auto-renew - it defaults to ON (1-year, 30-day window). To turn it off, send `subscription.autoRenew: false`.

request.description:
### Status sequence (Document Signer)
`pending-documents` -> `pending-approval` -> `pending-csr` -> `pending-agreement` -> `issued` (or `cancelled` / `revoked` / `expired`).

## Response

Same shape as **Create**, plus the lifecycle and supporting blocks filled in as the order progresses.

### Header fields

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | Always. |
| `requestId` | string | Always. |
| `status` | enum | Typed lifecycle state. Walks `pending-documents` -> `pending-csr` -> `pending-agreement` -> `pending-approval` -> `issued`. Legal Entity certs may also pass through `pending-organization-verification`. |
| `orderState` | string | Human-readable order status from the legacy pipeline, e.g. `Order Accepted`, `Approved by System`. Complement to the typed `status`. |
| `certificateState` | string | Human-readable certificate / request status, e.g. `Pending for Approver`, `Certificate Generated`. |
| `subjectType` | enum | `natural-person` / `legal-person` / `legal-entity`. |
| `subjectDisplayName` | string | Full name for Natural / Legal Person; organization name for Legal Entity. |
| `createdAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the order was placed. |
| `issuedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the certificate was issued; omitted before issuance. |
| `expiresAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Certificate `notAfter`. Populated once issued; remains populated after revocation / expiry. |

### `requestor`

The person who placed the order; useful for support tickets and audit. PII fields are decrypted from storage.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Full name. |
| `email` | string | Decrypted from storage. |
| `phone` | string | E.164 normalised (`+<isd><number>`). |
| `designation` | string | Job title / role. |

### `csrSubmitted`

Boolean. `true` once the integrator has POSTed a CSR via **Submit CSR**. The order can't progress to issuance until this flips.

### `subscription`

Billing entitlement window. Distinct from the certificate's own `notBefore` / `notAfter`: a single subscription
can host successive certificates (e.g. a re-issued cert during the subscription period).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `validityYears` | integer | Subscription length in years (typically `1`/`2`/`3`). |
| `endDate` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the subscription entitlement expires. |
| `status` | string | `active`, `expired`, or `cancelled`. Omitted when the underlying status is unknown or not yet classified. |

### `subscriberAgreement`

Whether the requestor has accepted the Subscriber Agreement. Returned for product families that require an SA.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `signed` | boolean | `true` once accepted. |
| `signerName` | string | Acceptor's name; omitted until signed. |
| `signedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Acceptance timestamp; omitted until signed. |
| `signedPlace` | string | Acceptor's location; omitted until signed. |

### `revocation` (populated only when `status = revoked`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | Human-readable revocation engine status (e.g. `Revoked`). |
| `reason` | enum | RFC 5280 reason name: `key-compromise`, `affiliation-changed`, `superseded`, `cessation-of-operation`, `certificate-hold`, `privilege-withdrawn`, `unspecified`, etc. |
| `processedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Effective revocation time (CA-recorded). |

### `verifications`

Per-verification-type state. Sub-blocks appear only when the product requires that verification type
For Private PKI this object is typically omitted entirely.

#### `verifications.domain` (SSL/TLS)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | Overall DCV state across all domains on the order: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `domains[]` | array | One entry per domain on the order (primary + SANs). |
|   `.domain` | string | FQDN being validated. |
|   `.domainStatus` | enum | `ACTIVE` / `INACTIVE` / `EXPIRED`. |
|   `.dcvMethod` | enum | `dns-txt` / `http-url`. |
|   `.dcvStatus` | enum | DCV state for this domain: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
|   `.verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When this domain was last successfully validated. |
|   `.caaStatus` | enum | CAA pre-check: `PASSED` / `FAILED` / `SKIPPED`. |

For per-attempt MPIC diagnostics (consensus, DNSSEC, per-perspective resolver results), call the dedicated
**Domains -> Last DCV Attempt** / **DCV Attempt History** endpoints.

#### `verifications.organization` (OV / EV)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `organizationName` | string | Display name as recorded on the order. |
| `consentStatus` | `"0"` \| `"1"` \| `"2"` | Email-consent state when the OV flow requires consent from the organization's primary representative. Omitted when not applicable. |
| `consentSentTo` | string | Email address consent was sent to (when `consentStatus` is present). |

For the full organization record (address, representatives, pre-vetted domains) call
**Accounts -> Get Organization**.

#### `verifications.email` (S/MIME)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `email` | string | Email address being validated (decrypted from storage). |
| `verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the email control challenge was last redeemed. |

#### `verifications.individual` (personal certificates)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `subjectName` | string | Full name as captured at identity check. |

### Status sequence
`pending-csr` -> `issued` (or `cancelled` / `revoked`). Private PKI typically skips approval queues - the CA is yours.

## Response

Same shape as **Create**, plus the lifecycle and supporting blocks filled in as the order progresses.

### Header fields

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | Always. |
| `requestId` | string | Always. |
| `status` | enum | Typed lifecycle state. Private PKI skips DCV; typical walk is `pending-csr` -> `pending-approval` -> `issued`. |
| `orderState` | string | Human-readable order status from the legacy pipeline, e.g. `Order Accepted`, `Approved by System`. Complement to the typed `status`. |
| `certificateState` | string | Human-readable certificate / request status, e.g. `Pending for Approver`, `Certificate Generated`. |
| `variant` | enum | Echo of the create-request variant. |
| `hostname` | string | Primary hostname / subject CN. |
| `createdAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the order was placed. |
| `issuedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the certificate was issued; omitted before issuance. |
| `expiresAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Certificate `notAfter`. Populated once issued; remains populated after revocation / expiry. |

### `requestor`

The person who placed the order; useful for support tickets and audit. PII fields are decrypted from storage.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Full name. |
| `email` | string | Decrypted from storage. |
| `phone` | string | E.164 normalised (`+<isd><number>`). |
| `designation` | string | Job title / role. |

### `csrSubmitted`

Boolean. `true` once the integrator has POSTed a CSR via **Submit CSR**. The order can't progress to issuance until this flips.

### `subscription`

Billing entitlement window. Distinct from the certificate's own `notBefore` / `notAfter`: a single subscription
can host successive certificates (e.g. a re-issued cert during the subscription period).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `validityYears` | integer | Subscription length in years (typically `1`/`2`/`3`). |
| `endDate` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the subscription entitlement expires. |
| `status` | string | `active`, `expired`, or `cancelled`. Omitted when the underlying status is unknown or not yet classified. |

### `subscriberAgreement`

Whether the requestor has accepted the Subscriber Agreement. Returned for product families that require an SA.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `signed` | boolean | `true` once accepted. |
| `signerName` | string | Acceptor's name; omitted until signed. |
| `signedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Acceptance timestamp; omitted until signed. |
| `signedPlace` | string | Acceptor's location; omitted until signed. |

### `revocation` (populated only when `status = revoked`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | Human-readable revocation engine status (e.g. `Revoked`). |
| `reason` | enum | RFC 5280 reason name: `key-compromise`, `affiliation-changed`, `superseded`, `cessation-of-operation`, `certificate-hold`, `privilege-withdrawn`, `unspecified`, etc. |
| `processedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Effective revocation time (CA-recorded). |

### `verifications`

Per-verification-type state. Sub-blocks appear only when the product requires that verification type
For Private PKI this object is typically omitted entirely.

#### `verifications.domain` (SSL/TLS)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | Overall DCV state across all domains on the order: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `domains[]` | array | One entry per domain on the order (primary + SANs). |
|   `.domain` | string | FQDN being validated. |
|   `.domainStatus` | enum | `ACTIVE` / `INACTIVE` / `EXPIRED`. |
|   `.dcvMethod` | enum | `dns-txt` / `http-url`. |
|   `.dcvStatus` | enum | DCV state for this domain: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
|   `.verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When this domain was last successfully validated. |
|   `.caaStatus` | enum | CAA pre-check: `PASSED` / `FAILED` / `SKIPPED`. |

For per-attempt MPIC diagnostics (consensus, DNSSEC, per-perspective resolver results), call the dedicated
**Domains -> Last DCV Attempt** / **DCV Attempt History** endpoints.

#### `verifications.organization` (OV / EV)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `organizationName` | string | Display name as recorded on the order. |
| `consentStatus` | `"0"` \| `"1"` \| `"2"` | Email-consent state when the OV flow requires consent from the organization's primary representative. Omitted when not applicable. |

**Accounts -> Get Organization**.

| Field | Type | Notes |

| `status` | enum | `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `email` | string | Email address being validated (decrypted from storage). |
| `verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When the email control challenge was last redeemed. |

| Field | Type | Notes |

| `subjectName` | string | Full name as captured at identity check. |
| `verifiedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | When identity was last successfully verified. |

### What it does
Renews an existing **independently-verified (ADN)** domain that is expired or within the renewal window. Same endpoint as **Add Domain**, but with `"mode": "renew"`. - `409` - inherited domain (renew the parent ADN instead) / renewal could not be completed.
- `422` - not eligible yet (only within the renewal window or after expiry).
- `403` - not authorized to manage this domain.

request.description:
### What it does
Runs the per-perspective MPIC verification. The CA queries multiple geographic vantage points, then checks the artefact you published.

### On success
- `dcvStatus` flips to `VERIFIED`.
- Domain becomes reusable in any SSL order under this account (no more DCV per cert).

### On failure
- **422** with a `diagnostics` block in the ProblemDetail showing per-perspective results, DNSSEC chain, and recommended next steps.
- Common causes: DNS not propagated yet (typical TTL 5-60 min), wrong record name (`_emudhra-challenge` vs apex), token mismatch, CAA record blocks emSign.

## Response

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | DCV result after this attempt: `PENDING` / `VERIFIED` / `REJECTED`. |
| `validatedAt` | RFC 3339 datetime | Set only when `status = VERIFIED`. |
| `diagnostics` | object | Per-perspective MPIC block (see _diagnostics shape_ below). Always populated. |

### `diagnostics` shape

The block carries the BR-MPIC consensus output. Useful keys:

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `consensus.agreed` | boolean | Whether perspectives reached quorum. |
| `consensus.consensusValue` | string | The value perspectives agreed on (e.g. observed TXT token). |
| `consensus.perspectiveCount` | integer | Number of vantage points consulted. |
| `consensus.quorumCount` | integer | Quorum threshold (typically 3). |
| `consensus.rirDiversityMet` | boolean | Whether the perspectives spanned enough Regional Internet Registries. |
| `perspectives[]` | array | One entry per vantage point. Each has `resolverIp`, `responseUrlValue` / `txtValue`, `errorMessage`, `dnssec.{validated,evidence}`. |
| `nextSteps[]` | array | Human-readable remediation hints. |
| `method` | string | MPIC method name (`CAA_TXT`, `CAA_EMAIL`, `WEBSITE_CHANGE`, etc.). |
| `failureClass` | string | One of `OK`, `DNS_NXDOMAIN`, `DNS_TIMEOUT`, `TOKEN_MISMATCH`, `CAA_MISSING`, `HTTP_4XX`, etc. Useful for programmatic retry logic. |

Same `diagnostics` shape is returned by `/domains/{id}/dcv/attempts/last` and `/domains/{id}/dcv/attempts/{attemptId}`.

### What it does
Returns every product your account is entitled to order, grouped by category (Document Signer / S/MIME / SSL/TLS / Private PKI). Each entry has a stable `productCode` + `productName` + pricing per validity year.

### Behaviour
- **No `groupNumber`** - wrapper defaults to your account's default billing group (`isDefaultDivision=1`). The previous behaviour of returning empty has been fixed.
- **With `groupNumber`** - strictly scoped to that group's entitlements.

### Sample response
```json
{
 "products": [{
 "currencyType": "USD",
 "categoryName": "SSL/TLS Certificates",
 "categoryID": "3",
 "products": [
 { "productCode": "842", "productName": "DV SSL Certificate", "subscriptionPrice": { "1 Year": { "cost": "100.0" } } },
 { "productCode": "843", "productName": "DV SSL Certificate Wildcard",... }
 ]
 }]
}
```

## Response

| Top-level field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `products` | array | Product groups available to your account. One entry per category. |

Each entry in `products[]`:

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `categoryName` | string | Human-readable category name. |
| `categoryID` | string | See **categoryID values** below. |
| `currencyType` | string | ISO 4217 currency the prices are quoted in (`INR`, `USD`, etc.). Account-scoped. |
| `products` | array | Individual products in this category. |

Each entry in the nested `products[]`:

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `productCode` | string | The catalog product code. Pass as `X-Product-Code` on Create to override auto-resolution. Used for billing reconciliation. |
| `productName` | string | Full marketing name, e.g. `emSign DV SSL Certificate - 1 Year`. |
| `price` | string | Per-unit price in `currencyType`. Decimal string (`"1000.0"`). Excludes taxes; the actual billed amount can differ for InCommon / contract customers. |
| `productTypeID` | string | Product sub-type. See **productTypeID values** below. |

### `categoryID` values

| Value | Category |
|---|---|
| `"1"` | Document Signer Certificates |
| `"2"` | S/MIME Certificates |
| `"3"` | SSL/TLS Certificates |
| `"8"` | Private PKI |

### `productTypeID` values

| Value | Product type | Family (categoryID) |
|---|---|---|
| `"10"` | Natural Person (NR) | Document Signer (`1`) |
| `"11"` | Legal Person (NR) | Document Signer (`1`) |
| `"12"` | Legal Entity (NR) | Document Signer (`1`) |
| `"13"` | DV SSL | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"14"` | DV SSL Wildcard | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"15"` | DV SSL UCC | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"16"` | OV SSL | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"17"` | OV SSL Wildcard | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"18"` | OV SSL UCC | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"19"` | EV SSL | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"20"` | EV SSL UCC | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"21"` | DV SSL Wildcard UCC | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"22"` | OV SSL Wildcard UCC | SSL/TLS (`3`) |
| `"39"` | Private PKI | Private PKI (`8`) |
| `"41"` | S/MIME | S/MIME (`2`) |

The exact `productTypeID` for a product is also derivable from `productName`. Use `productTypeID` for programmatic routing (e.g. "is this an EV SSL?"), `productName` for display.

### How to use

- For most callers, the wrapper resolves `productCode` automatically from the request body. You can call this endpoint to confirm which exact product/price the wrapper will pick.
- To pin a specific product (e.g. force an InCommon-branded SKU), copy the `productCode` and send it as `X-Product-Code: <code>` on the Create call.
- To list custom fields required by a specific product, call **Get Custom Fields for Product** with the chosen `productCode`.

request.description:
Returns mandatory + optional custom fields configured for the given product (cost-centre tags, project codes, etc.). Include them in `customFields[]` on order creation.

## Response

| Top-level field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `customFields` | array | Field groups required by this product. Empty array (`[]`) when the product has no custom fields beyond the standard request body. |

When non-empty, `customFields` contains a single object with two sub-arrays:

| Sub-field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `certificateInformation` | array | Standard cert subject fields the product needs (CN, O, L, etc.). Driven by the CA profile. |
| `additionalInformation` | array | Account-defined extra fields the product enforces (PO number, cost-centre, custom dropdowns, etc.). |

Each entry in either array:

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Display label, e.g. `First Name`, `Business Category`, `PO Number`. For Business Category entries on EV products, this is the field-group label; the dropdown values appear in `values[]` as `"<id>:<description>"` pairs. |
| `fieldId` | string | Present on `additionalInformation` only. Stable field number to send back on Create as `customFields[].fieldId`. |
| `type` | string | One of `text`, `dropdown`, `datePicker`, `checkbox`. Renders the appropriate UI input. |
| `maxlength` | string | Maximum length in characters. Empty for `checkbox` / `datePicker`. |
| `isMandatory` | `"0"` \| `"1"` | `"1"` when the field is required on Create; `"0"` when optional. |
| `values` | string[] | Present only when `type = dropdown`. Allowed values. For Business Category entries on EV: each entry is `"<id>:<description>"` (e.g. `"1:Private Organization"`) - submit the ID. |

### How to use

On a Create call, send each non-empty additional field as:

```json
"customFields": [
  { "fieldId": "<field's fieldId>", "value": "<user value>" }
]
```

Standard `certificateInformation` fields (First Name, Email, etc.) are sent as their normal request-body fields, not inside `customFields`.

The `type` field on each entry uses these values:

| Source value | `type` value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `"1"` | `text` | Free-text input. |
| `"2"` | `dropdown` | Pick one of `values[]`. |
| `"3"` | `datePicker` | Send ISO 8601 date string. |
| `"4"` | `checkbox` | Send `"true"` / `"false"`. |
| `"5"` | `text` | Multi-line free-text. |

request.description:
### What it does
Paginated, filterable order history across SSL / Document Signer / Private PKI.

## Response

Paginated list, Spring-style envelope:

| Top-level field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `content` | array | Page of order rows. |
| `page` | integer | 1-based page index (mirrors the `page` query param). |
| `size` | integer | Page size (mirrors the `size` query param). |
| `totalElements` | integer | Total orders matching the filter, across all pages. |
| `totalPages` | integer | Total page count. |

Each `content[]` row:

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `orderNumber` | string | Customer-visible order number. Use it with **Track Order** for full lifecycle detail. |
| `requestNumber` | string | Most-recent request identifier on the order (reissues create new requests). |
| `productCode` | string | Catalog product code. Cross-reference with **List Products** for human-readable name + category. |
| `orderStatus` | string | Human-readable order state: `Order Accepted`, `Approved by System`, `Pending for Approver`, `Issued`, etc. |
| `certificateStatus` | string | Human-readable request state: `Pending for Approver`, `Approved by System`, `Certificate Generated`, `Certificate Downloaded`, etc. |
| `certificateSerialNumber` | string | Hex serial assigned by the CA. Empty until issuance. |
| `certificateExpiryDate` | datetime | Certificate `notAfter`. Empty until issuance. |
| `issuerCA` | string | Issuing CA's CN. Empty until issuance. |
| `domainName` | string | Primary CN for SSL/TLS orders. Empty for non-SSL families. |
| `organizationName` | string | Organization on the order (OV/EV). Empty for unverified / personal orders. |
| `countryName` | string | Subject country (full name, not ISO code). |
| `groupNumber` | string | Billing group the order was filed under. |
| `customFields` | array | Customer-defined custom-field values on the order. Each: `{ fieldId, value }`. |
| `tags` | array | Customer-defined tags applied to the order. |
| `orderDate` | datetime | Order creation time (UTC). |

### What it does
Debit / credit ledger movements for the account. Pair with `groupNumber` to isolate a cost centre.

## Response

Paginated list, Spring-style envelope:

| Top-level field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `content` | array | Page of ledger statement rows. |
| `page` | integer | 1-based page index. |
| `size` | integer | Page size. |
| `totalElements` | integer | Total ledger entries matching the filter. |
| `totalPages` | integer | Total page count. |

Each `content[]` row is a statement entry: transaction date, description, debit / credit amount in the account's billing currency, balance after the entry, and the originating order / request number when the entry is tied to a specific order.

## CERTInext API v2 - Error Codes

Every error response follows **RFC 7807** and carries an `EMS-xxxx` code in `detail`.

### OAuth2 (`/oauth/token`) - RFC 6749 errors
| HTTP | `error` | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | Missing/empty `grant_type`, `client_id`, or `client_secret` | Populate the form fields |
| 400 | `unsupported_grant_type` | Value other than `client_credentials` or `refresh_token` | Use a supported grant |
| 400 | `invalid_grant` | Refresh token expired / used / revoked | Call **Get Bearer Token** to re-auth |
| 401 | `invalid_client` | Wrong `client_id` or `client_secret`, or key revoked | Regenerate the client secret in portal |
| 403 | `unauthorized_client` | Access key not generated in **OAuth mode** | Recreate with the OAuth radio selected |

### Order create (POST `/{product}-certificates`)
| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `EMS-915` | 422 | Invalid / unknown product code |
| `EMS-916` | 422 | Requestor info missing |
| `EMS-917` | 422 | Certificate info missing |
| `EMS-918` | 422 | Additional information missing |
| `EMS-919` | 422 | Subscription info missing |
| `EMS-920` | 422 | Agreement not accepted |

### DCV / CSR / Cancel / Revoke
| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `EMS-921` | 422 | CSR malformed |
| `EMS-922` | 422 | CSR subject mismatch |
| `EMS-940` | 422 | Reissue: invalid CSR |
| `EMS-941` | 422 | Reissue: reason missing |
| `EMS-964` | 422 | Rejection remarks cannot be empty |
| `EMS-969` | 422 | Revoke reason ID missing |
| `EMS-984` | 422 | Cancellation remarks cannot be empty |
| `EMS-1063` | 422 | SAN limit exceeded on reissue |
| `EMS-1080` | 422 | Domain already verified (Verify DCV no-op) |
| `EMS-1157` | 422 | Domain name cannot be empty |
| `EMS-1158` | 422 | DCV method cannot be empty |
| `EMS-1165` | 422 | Order not in a state that supports this operation |

### Domains (POST/GET `/domains/**`)
| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `EMS-DOMAIN-001` | 422 | CAA record blocks emSign issuance |
| `EMS-DOMAIN-002` | 409 | Domain already registered under your account |
| `EMS-DOMAIN-003` | 422 | Domain validation failed (PSL block, invalid format, etc.) |
| `EMS-DOMAIN-101` | 409 | Domain owned by another organization in your account (BR section 4.1) - `existingDomainId` returned |
| `EMS-DOMAIN-102` | 422 | Revalidation reset failed |
| `EMS-DOMAIN-103` | 422 | CAA pre-check failed; per-perspective `diagnostics` returned |

### Transport (RFC 7807)
| HTTP | Condition |
|---|---|
| 400 | Body malformed, header/param missing, field validation failed (`errors[]` itemised) |
| 401 | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
| 403 | Caller lacks permission |
| 404 | Resource doesn't exist under your account |
| 405 | Method not supported (`Allow` header lists what is) |
| 406 | Accept header can't be satisfied |
| 415 | Content-Type not supported |
| 422 | Body parsed but failed business validation |
| 429 | Rate limited (`Retry-After` header) |
| 500 | Internal error |
| 501 | Endpoint exists but the underlying handler isn't wired yet |

### Response body shape
```json
{
 "type": "https://api.certinext.io/errors/<slug>",
 "title": "Human-readable title",
 "status": 422,
 "detail": "Order not in a state that supports this operation",
 "instance": "/api/certinext/v2/ssl-certificates/<orderId>/revoke",
 "errors": [
 { "field": "certificate.domain", "message": "must not be blank" }
 ]
}
```

## Product Codes

The numeric `productCode` goes in the `X-Product-Code` header on every order create. The canonical source is **Catalog -> List Products** - these reference values match most environments but are authoritative only in the catalog response.

### SSL / TLS
| Code | Product | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `842` | DV SSL | Single FQDN, no org vetting |
| `843` | DV SSL Wildcard | `*.example.com` |
| `844` | DV SSL UCC | Multi-SAN |
| `845` | DV SSL Wildcard UCC | Wildcard primary + extra SANs |
| `846` | OV SSL | Single FQDN, vetted org subject |
| `847` | OV SSL Wildcard | `*.example.com` with vetted org |
| `848` | OV SSL UCC | Multi-SAN with vetted org |
| `849` | OV SSL Wildcard UCC | Wildcard + SANs with vetted org |
| `850` | EV SSL | Single FQDN, EV vetting |
| `851` | EV SSL UCC | Multi-SAN, EV vetting |

### Document Signer
| Code | Product |
|---|---|
| `819` | Natural Person - 1 year |
| `820` | Natural Person - 2 year |
| `821` | Natural Person - 3 year |
| `822` | Legal Person - 1 year |
| `823` | Legal Person - 2 year |
| `824` | Legal Person - 3 year |
| `825` | Legal Entity - 1 year |
| `826` | Legal Entity - 2 year |
| `827` | Legal Entity - 3 year |

### S/MIME (email signing / encryption)
| Code | Product |
|---|---|
| `903` | S/MIME Simple MV-S - 1 year |
| `904` | S/MIME Simple MV-S - 2 year |
| `905` | S/MIME Simple MV-S - 3 month |

### Private PKI
Private PKI codes vary per customer catalog. Query **Catalog -> List Products** with your token; entries with `categoryName="Private PKI Products"` enumerate what your account can order.

### Environment variables
Pre-filled in the env file as `productCodeSslDv`, `productCodeSslDvWildcard`, `productCodeSslDvUcc`, `productCodeSslDvWildcardUcc`, `productCodeSslOv`, `productCodeSslOvWildcard`, `productCodeSslOvUcc`, `productCodeSslOvWildcardUcc`, `productCodeDocSignerNp1Y`, `productCodeDocSignerLp1Y`, `productCodeDocSignerLe1Y`, `productCodePkiIntranet`, `productCodePkiIgtf`.

## Country Codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)

All `countryCode` fields use **two-letter uppercase**. For integrations:

| Code | Country |

| `US` | United States |
| `CA` | Canada |
| `MX` | Mexico |
| `GB` | United Kingdom |
| `DE` | Germany |
| `FR` | France |

| `IN` | India |
| `BR` | Brazil |

Full list: https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search

## Phone format (E.164)

US / Canada -> country code `+1`, then a 10-digit number, no spaces or dashes:

```
+14155551234 (San Francisco)
+12025551234 (Washington DC)
+16175551234 (Boston)
+15125551234 (Austin)
+17185551234 (New York / Brooklyn)
```

## Currency

US pricing returned as `currencyType: "USD"` in the catalog. Other ISO 4217 codes (CAD, MXN, EUR, GBP) appear when ordering from non-US billing groups.
